nodes.name: Mark start
nodes.notes: Remembers when this run began and what started it (for the run duration and trigger).

nodes.name: Split approvals
nodes.notes: One item per claimed approval, or an idle marker when there is nothing to run.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { idle: true, executed: 0, n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id) } }];

nodes.name: Google Calendar: create event
nodes.notes: NOT VERIFIED - needs a Google Calendar OAuth credential (connect it in n8n, then enable this node).

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map((i) => { if (i.json.kind !== 'calendar#event') throw new Error('Google Calendar did not return an event (is the node enabled and connected?)'); return i; });

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'run.finished', workflow_key: 'approved-actions', n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), n8n_workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: $workflow.name, trigger: $('Mark start').first().json._trigger, status: $json.status, result: { executed: $json.executed, failed: $json.failed }, error: $json.failed ? $json.errors.join('; ') : null, duration_ms: Math.max(0, Date.now() - $('Mark start').first().json._t0) }) }}

meta.description: Executes actions a person has approved.
